purpose: The relationship law for the WHOLE SOCC brand ecosystem. SOCC births many customer-facing entities; without an architecture they become chaos (inconsistent) or a liability (one tainted brand drags the rest). This decides how SOCC, ANNA, and every future entity relate.

branded_house.examples: Google Maps / Google Drive; FedEx Express
branded_house.con: one failure taints all; forces the master name onto every audience

house_of_brands.pro: each targets a distinct audience; risk isolated
house_of_brands.con: expensive; no trust transfer between them

endorsed.con: parent must be a trust asset to the buyer

hybrid.examples: Amazon (Branded House + Audible/Twitch as House of Brands)

soccs_reality: buyers are non-technical, per-vertical (clinic owner, barbershop owner...) — they do NOT know or care about 'SOCC'
the stealth-human thesis means each PRODUCT is experienced as a PERSON (Анна), not software
SOCC is the BRAINS/OS — internal, matrix-aesthetic, never customer-facing
one Forge mints them all -> shared CRAFT, but each needs a distinct vertical FACE

ruling.what_it_is: House of Brands at the CUSTOMER layer (each entity is its own human-named persona; SOCC stays invisible) + Branded House of CRAFT/DNA internally (every face forged from one Forge, one token system, one quality bar).
why: non-technical buyers buy a person ('Анна'), not a tech parent — exposing 'SOCC' would only confuse/cool them
stealth-human demands each product BE a believable person with a human name
risk isolation: if one persona stumbles, it doesn't taint the others (vital while young)
but the FORGE gives shared craft DNA -> consistency + speed without a visible master brand
ruling.rejected: Branded House ('SOCC Анна', 'SOCC Барбер') — forces the techy parent onto warmth-buyers and breaks stealth. Endorsed ('Анна by SOCC') — only works once SOCC is a trusted consumer name (it isn't, and shouldn't be).

the_family_concept: SOCC runs an INVISIBLE COMPANY whose products are a STAFF of human-named AI specialists — Анна (стоматология), Марк (барбершоп), … — each a believable person, each a re-skin of the same forge DNA, all run by the unseen SOCC brain.
shared_DNA_locked_across_all_faces: the same design-token STRUCTURE (bg/ink/primary/accent/semantic + type scale + radius/space)
rounded-tile mark + monogram patient-avatar system (dual-identity law)
humanist type, restraint = premium, ONE warm accent on a trust base
stealth-human voice law (warm, no robot tells, graceful human handoff)
SOCC proof-gated craft (truth_boundary, REVIEW, no fake PASS)
per_face_skin_varies: archetype (Caregiver/Sage for clinic; Everyman/Hero for barber...)
naming_convention: human first names only, chosen to fit the vertical's audience; NEVER 'SOCC X'. Stealth requires a person, not a product name.
proof_of_factory: SYSTEM/BRAND_FORGE/frontiers/entity2 (Марк barbershop face minted as a re-skin to prove the forge produces a consistent-yet-distinct family)
truth_boundary: Brand architecture ruling for the SOCC ecosystem. Strategic framework + recommendation + the shared-DNA / per-skin split + naming law. Mints one proof face (Марк). No live entity birth, no network, no revenue, no AGI.
